SET IMPLICIT_TRANSACTIONS OFF;
SET NOCOUNT ON;
MERGE [LKRiskRequests] USING (
VALUES (@p0, @p1, @p2, @p3, @p4, @p5, @p6, @p7, @p8, 0),
(@p9, @p10, @p11, @p12, @p13, @p14, @p15, @p16, @p17, 1),
(@p18, @p19, @p20, @p21, @p22, @p23, @p24, @p25, @p26, 2),
(@p27, @p28, @p29, @p30, @p31, @p32, @p33, @p34, @p35, 3),
(@p36, @p37, @p38, @p39, @p40, @p41, @p42, @p43, @p44, 4)) AS i ([Id], [CreatedBy], [CreatedOn], [FromSeed], [NameAr], [NameEn], [State], [UpdatedBy], [UpdatedOn], _Position) ON 1=0
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
INSERT ([Id], [CreatedBy], [CreatedOn], [FromSeed], [NameAr], [NameEn], [State], [UpdatedBy], [UpdatedOn])
